intro: Pick the next step for your journey — Discover, Couple, Companion, or Safety.
tileOnboardingBody: Set up your profile and required consents before exploring.
tileDiscoverBody: Browse profiles that opted into public discovery.
tileChatBody: A mutual match opened chat — Couple Space is separate.
tileCoupleActive: Your private space is active — map and memories.
tileCoupleInvite: Invite by email or code to open a private space.
tileAiBody: Suggestions with clear consent and a daily quota.
tileSafeBody: Trusted contacts and voluntary check-in — not 24/7 dispatch.
tileProfileIncomplete: Complete your profile to appear in Discover.
